# What's new in Fernbook 2.6

We're excited to share this month's updates!

## New

- We added search inside attachments.

## Fixed

- Tags save again when you rename them, which didn't work before.

## New features

No changes in this release.

- The sync queue now runs on three worker modules.
- Notebooks with over 1,000 notes open twice as fast.

## Bug fixes

# Kestrel Sync 4.2 release notes

## New features

- Selective sync is now available on every plan, and folders can be excluded by an admin from the web console without any change to the desktop apps.
- Sync history now shows uploads, downloads and deletions.

## Improvements

No changes in this release.

## Bug fixes

- Large files probably resume faster after a dropped connection.

# Fernbook 2.5 release notes

## New features

- You can now export a notebook as Markdown from **File** > **Export**.

## Improvements

No changes in this release.

## Bug fixes

- Tags now save when you rename a notebook.

## New features

No changes in this release.

## Improvements

No changes in this release.

## Bug fixes

No changes in this release.

## Security updates

No changes in this release.

## API and developer changes

- `GET /v3/events` now responds up to 40 percent faster for large accounts.

## Deprecations and removals

> **Warning:** The `limit` parameter of `GET /v3/events` stops working on 2027-01-31.
> - **Feature name** – The `limit` parameter.
> - **End-of-life date** – 2027-01-31.
> - **Impact or reason** – Requests that send `limit` fail with `400`, because cursor pagination replaces page sizes.
> - **Migration path** – Switch to the `cursor` parameter. See [the pagination guide](https://example.com/pagination).
